verdict.rationale: Trivy is a CLI scanner that runs via binary or Docker image. Community users say it is 'super easy to integrate in every ci/cd pipeline' and that they run it in CI, so the core of running scans in pipelines is supported. However, nothing in the pack documents exit-code behavior for failing builds or any way to flag only new findings. Missing for 10: documented exit-code/fail-build options, per-pull-request diff or baseline filtering for new findings, first-party CI integration docs.
